proposal.engineer_radio_message: Pit now for softs, clear rejoin ahead. Stay out on the new tyres until the end of the race to maximize performance and save time compared to other options available under VSC conditions. Good luck, Lewis! Keep it smooth and safe out there.
proposal.rationale: Given that the Virtual Safety Car (VSC) is deployed, it's an optimal time for Hamilton to pit as the penalty hold is zero, and the field is slowed down. Pitting now for softs will provide a significant performance gain compared to staying on hard tyres or switching to mediums. The rejoin position is clear, allowing for a smooth transition back onto the track.
